retry_reasons: ST-3 still says claim warns and succeeds when the Iteration cannot be started, against IT-4
ticket move decides the immediate and exclusive write from the local index before the fetch, so a start found after the fetch is not exclusive
CL-3 does not name the Iteration start by ticket move among the writes pushed at once
The ADR-009 bullet repeats the cases already in IT-4 and the help instead of the decision and reason
